CREATE TABLE "public"."Profile" (
  "availability" text NOT NULL,
  "certifications" text[] NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "degree" text NOT NULL,
  "experience" json NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "jobLevel" text NOT NULL,
  "languages" text[] NOT NULL,
  "projects" json NOT NULL,
  "roles" text[] NOT NULL,
  "skills" text[] NOT NULL,
  "university" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "workEnvironment" text NOT NULL,
  "workLocation" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Profile_certifications_elem_not_null_e7bbbdcb" CHECK (array_position("certifications", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "Profile_languages_elem_not_null_d4aa0a00" CHECK (array_position("languages", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "Profile_roles_elem_not_null_37524d49" CHECK (array_position("roles", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "Profile_skills_elem_not_null_79c19a4f" CHECK (array_position("skills", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "username" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
